statement: Find all integer solutions to \(m^{m+n} = n^{12}\) and \(n^{m+n} = m^3\).
Find all triangles \(ABC\) such that \(\dfrac{a\cos A + b\cos B + c\cos C}{a\sin A + b\sin B + c\sin C} = \dfrac{a+b+c}{9R}\), where \(a, b, c\) are the side lengths and \(R\) is the circumradius.

Let \(P\) be a point inside triangle \(ABC\). The perpendicular distances from \(P\) to the three sides have product \(p\). Show that \(p \leq \dfrac{8S^3}{27abc}\), where \(S\) is the area of \(ABC\) and \(a, b, c\) are the sides. Prove a similar result for a tetrahedron.
Find all three-digit integers \(\overline{abc} = n\) such that \(\dfrac{2n}{3} = a!b!c!\).

Let \(L, L'\) be two skew lines and \(p\) a plane not containing either. A variable line \(M\) parallel to \(p\) meets \(L\) at \(X\) and \(L'\) at \(Y\). Find the position of \(M\) that minimizes \(XY\). Also, given another fixed line \(L''\), find the line \(M\) that is also perpendicular to \(L''\).
Show that \(\dfrac{1}{x_1^n} + \dfrac{1}{x_2^n} + \cdots + \dfrac{1}{x_k^n} \geq k^{n+1}\) for positive reals \(x_i\) with sum 1.
